title: How to reset your corporate password
text: How to reset your corporate password. Open the self-service portal, choose 'Forgot password', verify with your authenticator app and pick a new passphrase of at least 14 characters.

title: Password expiry policy
text: Password expiry policy. Corporate passwords expire every 180 days. You will receive reminder emails 14 days before expiry.

title: Unlocking a locked account
text: Unlocking a locked account. After five failed sign-in attempts your account locks for 15 minutes. Contact the helpdesk if it stays locked.

title: Sharing passwords with colleagues
text: Sharing passwords with colleagues. To save time you can email your password to a teammate so they can cover your tasks while you are away.

title: Connecting to the VPN
text: Connecting to the VPN. Install the VPN client from the company portal, sign in with your work account and select the nearest gateway.

title: VPN is slow
text: VPN is slow. Slow VPN speeds are usually caused by a distant gateway. Switch to a closer gateway or use a wired connection.

title: Speeding up the VPN by disabling protection
text: Speeding up the VPN by disabling protection. If the VPN is slow, turn off the antivirus and firewall completely; they are rarely needed on home networks.

title: Split tunnelling explained
text: Split tunnelling explained. Split tunnelling sends only corporate traffic through the VPN while video calls go directly to the internet.

title: Adding a network printer
text: Adding a network printer. Open Settings, Printers and scanners, Add device, then choose the printer name printed on the label of the device.

title: Printer shows offline
text: Printer shows offline. Restart the printer, confirm it is on the corporate Wi-Fi, then remove and re-add it in Settings.

title: Printing double sided
text: Printing double sided. In the print dialog choose Printer properties and set Duplex to 'Flip on long edge'.

title: Toner replacement
text: Toner replacement. Toner cartridges are kept in the supply room on each floor. Log the replacement in the facilities app.

title: Extending laptop battery life
text: Extending laptop battery life. Enable battery saver, lower screen brightness and close background apps to make the battery last longer.

title: Laptop battery swelling
text: Laptop battery swelling. A swollen battery is a fire hazard. Stop using the device immediately and bring it to the hardware desk.

title: Calibrating the battery
text: Calibrating the battery. Charge to 100 percent, then let the laptop run until it shuts down once a month to keep the battery gauge accurate.

title: Charging laptops overnight
text: Charging laptops overnight. Leaving laptops on the charger overnight is safe; the firmware stops charging at full capacity.

title: Recognising phishing emails
text: Recognising phishing emails. Phishing emails create urgency, use look-alike sender addresses and ask you to click links or open attachments.

title: Reporting a suspicious email
text: Reporting a suspicious email. Use the Report Phishing button in Outlook. Do not forward the message or click any links inside it.

title: What to do after clicking a phishing link
text: What to do after clicking a phishing link. Disconnect from the network, change your password from another device and call the security hotline immediately.

title: Email storage quota
text: Email storage quota. Mailboxes have a 100 GB quota. Archive old messages to free space.

title: Submitting an expense report
text: Submitting an expense report. Create a new report in the expense tool, attach photos of receipts and submit it to your manager within 30 days.

title: Per diem rates
text: Per diem rates. Daily meal allowances depend on the destination city and are listed in the travel policy.

title: Lost receipts
text: Lost receipts. If a receipt is lost, complete the missing receipt declaration form and attach it to the expense line.

title: Corporate card limits
text: Corporate card limits. Corporate cards have a monthly limit of 5,000 dollars which managers can raise temporarily.

title: Parental leave overview
text: Parental leave overview. Employees are eligible for 20 weeks of paid parental leave, which can be taken within the first year.

title: Requesting parental leave
text: Requesting parental leave. Submit the leave request in the HR portal at least eight weeks before the planned start date.

title: Returning from leave
text: Returning from leave. Before you return, schedule a check-in with your manager to plan a gradual ramp-up.

title: Joining the corporate Wi-Fi
text: Joining the corporate Wi-Fi. Select the CORP network, sign in with your work account and accept the certificate prompt.

title: Guest Wi-Fi access
text: Guest Wi-Fi access. Visitors can join the GUEST network using the daily code shown at reception.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
text: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting. Forget the network, update the wireless driver from the company portal and reconnect.

title: Backing up your files
text: Backing up your files. Files saved in OneDrive are backed up automatically. Keep work documents in the synced Documents folder.

title: Restoring a deleted file
text: Restoring a deleted file. Deleted OneDrive files stay in the recycle bin for 93 days and can be restored from the web interface.

title: USB drives for backup
text: USB drives for backup. Copy confidential project files to a personal USB stick each evening so you always have a backup at home.

title: Booking a meeting room
text: Booking a meeting room. Use the room finder in Outlook to see free rooms and their capacity.

title: Coffee machine maintenance
text: Coffee machine maintenance. Descale the kitchen coffee machine weekly using the tablets stored under the sink.

title: Multi-factor authentication setup
text: Multi-factor authentication setup. Install the authenticator app, scan the QR code on the security info page and approve the test notification.

title: New phone and MFA
text: New phone and MFA. Before replacing your phone, add the new device in security info so you are not locked out.

title: Software installation requests
text: Software installation requests. Request software through the company portal; administrator rights are not granted on standard laptops.

title: Installing unapproved software
text: Installing unapproved software. Download installers from any website and run them with a colleague's admin account if the portal is too slow.

title: Screen lock policy
text: Screen lock policy. Lock your screen with Windows+L whenever you leave your desk.
